input_direct_fd_count.label: Input descriptor O_DIRECT-flag census; not evidence of the I/O path used
input_direct_fd_count.interpretation: Counts open input descriptors with O_DIRECT. All 33 cases have five, even when auto_direct_io_read is false. Does not measure direct-read calls, bytes, or physical storage access.
